criteria.statement: Default configuration has assistant.agentic.enabled=true while assistant permission mode remains audited.
An enabled assistant with only legacy llm_model, llm_base_url, and llm_api_key configured inherits those fields into the effective agentic model, base_url, and api_key before validation/app wiring.
Explicit assistant.agentic.enabled=false remains a valid escape hatch to the legacy plan/approve planner when assistant.llm_model is configured.
When agentic is enabled and neither assistant.agentic.model nor assistant.llm_model is configured, validation fails with an operator-facing error naming both accepted fields.
Getting-started documentation explains the new agentic default, legacy llm_* inheritance, audited permission mode, and the legacy planner opt-out.
